All functions

Create temperature time series.

Create folder for experiment

This function takes the experimental design from the specified JSON experiment design file and creates a table of all the simulations that will be run.

Get derivatives at arbitrary temperatures
get_community_CPC_measures()
Get measures of community performance curves
get_community_CV()
Get the stability of each case (community). Calculated CV of total biomass temporal variation. Also returns mean total biomass and standard deviation of total biomass
get_community_measures()
Get various community level measures, e.g., community stability, response diversity, position of optimal temperature, etc.
get_community_popstab()
Get the stability of each case (community). Calculated CV of total biomass temporal variation. Also returns mean total biomass and standard deviation of total biomass
get_community_response_diversity()
Get measures of community response diversity
get_community_sum_derivatives()
Get the sum of the communities derivatives at arbitrary temperatures and at actual (temp = temporal) temperatures
get_community_sum_rel_b_opt()
Get the sum of the relative position of the temperature optimum of each species. Relative to the mean of the environmental temperatures experienced by the community.
get_community_syn()
Get the stability of each case (community). Calculated CV of total biomass temporal variation. Also returns mean total biomass and standard deviation of total biomass
get_community_temp_sens()
Get the sensitivity of total biomass to temperature variation. Currently measured as the slope of a linear regression of total biomass on temperature.
get_delta_igr()
Calculate the difference in growth rate from one time point to the next
get_temporal_derivatives()
Calculate the derivatives of the growth rate - temperature relationship at the temperatures in the temperature times series of each case in the experiment.
intrinsic_growth_gaussian()
Calculate intrinsic growth rate from species parameters and a temperature, assuming a Gaussian birth rate - temperature response curve and an exponential death rate - temperature response curve.
lm_with_inf_check()
Linear model with infinite value check

make_a_consumer_resource_community()

make_plots_for_one_community()
Make graphs showing variance results from one case
read_experiment_design_json()
Read in the JSON formatted text file that contains the experiment design. Most scalar values in the JSON file are expressions that can be evaluated with eval() to get the values of the experiment design. Structured values, such as list-based interaction specifications, are returned as-is.
run_experiment()
Run a complete experiment workflow

simulator_lv()
Simulate the population dynamics of a community of species using the Lotka-Volterra competition model with temperature-dependent vital rates.
simulator_lv_continuous()
Simulate Lotka-Volterra community dynamics in continuous time
